```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ent "<!ENTITY internal 'Expanded Value'>">
  %ent;
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY banner SYSTEM "banner.png" NDATA png>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns/root" xmlns:sub="http://example.com/ns/sub">
  <!-- Comment containing CDATA-like markup: <![CDATA[test]]> -->
  <sub:child id="c1">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section with entities like &internal; and tags <child>test</child>
    ]]>
  </sub:child>
  <child>&internal;</child>
</root>
```

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item+)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ATTLIST item id ID #REQUIRED>
  <!ENTITY ent1 "Data 1">
  <!ENTITY ent2 "&ent1; Data 2">
  <!ENTITY % paramEntity "<!ELEMENT note (#PCDATA)>">
  %paramEntity;
]>
<?pi-target processing instruction data with "quotes"?>
<catalog xmlns="http://xml.org/catalog" xmlns:x="http://xml.org/x">
  <!-- Comment 1: Testing DTD parameter entities and attributes -->
  <item id="i1">
    <![CDATA[
      First CDATA block with <tags> and &ent2;
    ]]>
  </item>
  <x:note>Some note text</x:note>
</catalog>
```

</document>

<!DOCTYPE log [
  <!ELEMENT log (entry)*>
  <!ELEMENT entry (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY log-ent "LogMessage">
  <!ENTITY % dtd-macro "<!ATTLIST entry level CDATA #IMPLIED>">

]>

<log xmlns="http://example.com/log" xmlns:sys="http://example.com/sys">
  <!-- Log file header comment -->
  <sys:entry level="error">

    ]]>
  </sys:entry>
  <entry>&log-ent;</entry>
</log>
